name: Desert Locust Density-Dependent Phase State (Resonance Raman of Hemolymph)
description: Resonance Raman spectra of hemolymph from desert locust (Schistocerca gregaria) juveniles reared in crowded vs. isolated conditions -- the classic density-dependent phase polyphenism studied in locust biology. 5,000 spectra from 200 individual animals (~25 replicate spectra per animal). Target: rearing density/phase state, crowded vs. isolated (binary classification). The dataset's own `Sample` column identifies which animal each spectrum came from and is used as an explicit group id.
